effectiveModel: Uniform deterministic bit algorithm with worst-case running time.

sourceBasis.step: Encode the requirement that exactly one variable in each pair is true by two CNF clauses per pair, preserving the variable count n. Specialize the word construction to two truth-value symbols. Add opposite unit clauses on two fresh variables. With L=n+2 positions and L+1 filler symbols, the two clauses ensure that both truth values and all fillers occur, giving q=d+4. For each length-L center, some filler is absent. The words using that filler require a satisfying literal in every clause. Conversely, a satisfying assignment agrees with every word. The encoding is polynomial and d=n+1 preserves the effective exponent scale.
